# PN-AUT-001 — Academic and Technical Bibliography

## Standards and normative references
1. IEC 60909-0 — Short-circuit currents in three-phase a.c. systems — calculation basis for prospective fault currents.
2. IEC 61439-1:2020 — Low-voltage switchgear and controlgear assemblies — general rules, characteristics and verification.
3. IEC 60529 — Degrees of protection provided by enclosures (IP Code).
4. IEC 60364-5-52 — Selection and erection of wiring systems — cable installation/current-carrying basis.
5. IEC 60287 series — Electric cables — calculation of current rating.
6. IEC 61131-3 — PLC programming languages, already required by the project FD.

## Manufacturer engineering references
- Schneider Electric — Electrical Installation Guide: LV design, short-circuit, conductor sizing, voltage drop and protection coordination.
- Schneider Electric — Harmony ST6 HMIST6500 user manual.
- Schneider Electric — ClimaSys cooling-unit technical documentation.
- Siemens — SIMATIC ET 200SP system/product data, including HART AI module.
- Siemens — SITRANS temperature measurement portfolio.
- Trane — TVR Smart Controls/Gateways product literature.
- ADEL System — CBI2420A data sheet.
- NOVUS — TEMP-WM and HART temperature transmitter families.

## Academic / book-like technical references
- Phase to Phase, *Networks for Electricity Distribution*, Chapter 8: short-circuit calculations and IEC 60909 concepts. https://www.phasetophase.nl/book/book_2_8.html
- *Short-Circuit Calculation and Overcurrent Relay Protection in AC Microgrids: A Review*, Energies, 2026, DOI: 10.3390/en19112510.
- Chen, S.; Lund, T.; Zamastil, M.H.; Akhmatov, V.; Abildgaard, H.; Gellert, B.C., conference paper comparing IEC 60909, superposition and iterative short-circuit methods in converter-rich grids, DOI: 10.1109/energytech.2012.6304664.

## Use rule
Academic and secondary references explain methods and provide independent cross-checks. They do not supersede the project's applicable standards, Petrobras documents or manufacturer data for the selected equipment.
